Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Vine Throw Pillow - 17 x 17 Inch, Black / Ivory
Colors: Black/Ivory
Made in USA and imported Black and white vine pattern in chenille yarns adds texture and brings a modern touch to your decor. Solid black back balances the pattern on the front. Hidden zipper at bottom of pillow. 17"L x 17"W Pillow cover and insert Spot clean. Pillow arrives in vacuum-sealed bag. Carefully remove pillow from packaging and let it fully expand.
